question: 'Arthashastra', an ancient Indian Sanskrit treatise on statecraft, political science, economic policy and military strategy was written by _________.
solution: The correct answer is __**Vishnugupta**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Vishnugupta: • Vishnugupta was the last known ruler of the later Gupta dynasty. • His reign was marked by the decline of the Gupta Empire due to invasions by the Huna people, among other factors. • Despite the significantly degraded power of the Guptas during his reign, Vishnugupta still endeavoured to hold back the Huna invasions. • There's evidence suggesting he may have achieved short-lived success in this struggle, but the broader decline of the Gupta Empire couldn't be reversed.
